# PicoSHA2

Source: https://github.com/okdshin/PicoSHA2

Revision: `161cb3fc4170fa7a3eca9e582cebd27cc4d1fe29`

`picosha2.h` retains the upstream MIT license. It supplies portable SHA-256
for the standalone Sunway correctness checker, without a target OpenSSL
dependency. The application's SDK and performance paths do not use it.
